temporal_notes: Mosquito larvae were collected during the main rainy season (April/May) between 2011 and 2013 across four sites on Unguja (Mwera, Chuini, Kilimani, Cheju).
source_text: Anopheles larvae were collected from breeding pools across Unguja and Pemba during the main rainy season (April/May) between 2011 and 2013 (Figure 1). The sites were chosen to represent the typical diversity of breeding grounds present on the islands... Four sites were sampled from Unguja: Mwera, Chuini, Kilimani, and Cheju.

temporal_notes: Mosquito larvae were collected during the main rainy season (April/May) between 2011 and 2013 across breeding sites on Pemba (Pujini, Kiungoni, Uwandani, Mangwena, Tumbe, Chwale).
source_text: The breeding sites from Pemba were located in Pujini, Kiungoni, Uwandani, Mangwena and Tumbe. The majority of mosquitoes from these were sampled within rural inland settings with the exception of Tumbe which lies close to the north coast of the island.
